entries.3c8517d5fc501158: This business centers on operating the travel comparison site "Travelko". "Travelko" is a metasearch site that lets users search and compare, online and in one place, travel products such as package tours, hotels and air tickets sold by more than 1,500 booking sites (as of the end of March 2026), including major domestic travel agencies, domestic and overseas OTAs, and domestic and overseas hotels and airlines. Users can use the service free of charge to find travel products that match their preferred conditions and make reservations or inquiries. The consolidated subsidiary Hotel Skip Co., Ltd. operates the hotel booking site "Hotelia" and the air ticket booking site "Travelia", and also sells travel products to corporate customers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,453 million.

entries.58f544a5a718aef7: Its corporate philosophy is to 'continue to contribute to the prosperity, joy and future of society by not fearing new challenges and with relentless innovation,' and under its mission to 'quickly respond to changing market needs and achieve No.1 customer satisfaction with the fastest speed and the highest quality,' it develops its business centered on the operation of Travelko. As priority issues, it cites responding to technological innovation, including generative AI; strengthening Travelko's service functions and developing new menus; raising brand awareness; strengthening overseas business, including inbound response through multilingual expansion; and developing new services and new businesses. For new businesses, it states that it will promote the introduction of new menus such as cruises to Travelko and the implementation of an AI search function; the provision of AI-based services for corporate customers; expanded introduction of online booking systems and business travel systems for travel agencies; and the start of an EC marketplace business for traditional crafts at KOGEI JAPAN.
